about.title: About
paragraphs: I hold an associate degree in Systems Analysis and Development from UNIP (2023).
Before programming, I worked in technical support and in customer service at Concentrix, where I diagnosed problems, talked to users and logged incidents.
Today I build web applications with React and TypeScript on the front end and REST APIs in C# / ASP.NET Core with SQL Server, with automated tests and CI.
I'm looking for a junior developer position in São Paulo or remote.
